phase: G3 recovery phase2, numbered stage V1
status: frozen before implementation and before any new simulation results
scope: Only recovery_phase2 writes; core theory/results, src, audit and validation retained read-only. No novelty claim for standard causal PI recovery.

controller.DC_PI: At PWM starts eW=Wset-W; cP=clip(100*eW+2500*zW,-5000,5000) W. Update zW+=Ts*eW unless this drives an already saturated raw output farther into saturation. Actual measured W and constant setpoint only.
controller.inventory: uB=clip(20*(B-Bset),-10000,10000) W during warmup and recovery, disabled during service. Actual measured B only. b follows actual tau and actual hard slew limiter.
controller.service: At first PWM period containing authorized onset, hold last current cP and zW through onset+T; original exact polynomial u feedforward byte-preserved, no uB. Existing known P/Q service schedule and current PI/feedforward retained. P command adds held pre-onset cP; no W/B feedback borrowing during service.
controller.recovery: After the first PWM boundary at or after onset+T, resume same DC PI and inventory feedback, original d=650 kW continues, P model baseline, Q=0, no future workload sensing, no counterfactual reference input, no parameter adaptation.
allowed_online_inputs: actual present measured current/voltage, W, B
constant declared W/B and baseline setpoints
original prerecorded authorized service P/Q/d/u schedule
controller.checkpoint: Fixed warmup completes on a PWM boundary at absolute grid time 2.0 s. Clone ALL state: iabc,W,B,b,current PI integrals,zW,last cP,held cP,clock/PWM phase. Each service and no-service pair has identical checkpoint, integration step and actual plant parameters. Healthy evolves freely with same PI/inventory control; evaluation only. No reset after service. The healthy fork uses the identical service-clock gates and PI freeze/resume timing, but P=baseline,Q=0,d=650 kW,uFeed=0 during that window. No-service output is never read by service control.
controller.sampling_note: Command/feedforward uses existing start/midpoint sampling with known schedule. Controller hold spans the first PWM period containing onset, at most 100 us early. Recovery enables at the first PWM boundary at or after T, at most 100 us late. This timing is identical across trials and not tuned.

execution_order: nominal common-clock two identical healthy forks; must be bitwise identical
held-out full factorial tau4/6ms x ramp25/35MWs x onset37/73us, each dt1us and0.5us

metrics.warmup_periodicity: Healthy warmup qualification: max successive-grid-cycle differences over last five 20 ms cycles: W/B<=0.1 J and abc currents<=0.2 A; same check on final healthy recovery window. Report cycle mean W−21600 J, W ripple and cycle-mean drift. These thresholds are frozen and failed qualification invalidates the corresponding matched-health result.
metrics.hard_bounds: All numerical integration extrema: W-derived V, instantaneous abs each phase and space-vector current, B,b,u,actual bdot. Report requested raw commands, all clamping and PWM duty utilization; saturations alone are not failed health, physical-bound violation is.
metrics.service_tracking: Ten 20 ms bins relative to declared onset. Max absolute bin mean actual P minus authorized nominal P <=2000 W, Q<=10000 var. Also report instantaneous and PWM-cycle extrema and tracking, with baseline held correction separately.
metrics.recovery_window: Final five phase-matched 20 ms cycles ending onset+T+0.5 s. PWM-boundary samples and a fixed common 1 us grid in this final 100 ms are compared offline.
metrics.tolerance_rationale: 2 J is 0.0093% Wset and 0.004% Bset, well above prior fine-step closure error; 2 A is 0.13% of phase rating. These are explicitly approximate engineering return tolerances, not exact finite-time recovery.
metrics.cost: Recovery-window integral starts at declared onset+T and ends T+0.5 s, measured grid P minus independently evolved matched healthy P; report signed net, absolute net, positive-only energy, and whether abs net <=100 J. Also report all costs against model-baseline P and separately report healthy baseline correction/loss bias. Incremental cP budget uses service-minus-matched-health. Report main-service and total extra energies separately, exact stored-energy/loss/load decomposition and numerical residual. Continue both branches for an additional 0.2 s after the recovery deadline with d=650 kW; report incremental post-deadline energy and total service-through-observation cost to reveal downstream debt. Absolute and positive-only integrals use phase-matched PWM-cycle mean active power, explicitly distinguished from signed net exact quadrature.
metrics.numerics: Event-aligned original explicit midpoint; two integration steps; preserve all V1 failures. Energy closure target <=0.1 J and coarse/fine terminal W/B delta<=0.1 J, phase-current delta<=0.1 A are quality checks; failure reported without hidden tuning.

stop_rule: Run all frozen cells and report; if any hard-bound/tracking/recovery/budget test fails preserve V1 and require numbered explicit revision before repair; do not change workload, checkpoint setpoints, horizon, parameters, tolerances or gains.
